headline: Renames the Central Falls, Rhode Island post office at 575 Dexter Street after abolitionist and suffragist Elizabeth Buffum Chace.
what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 575 Dexter Street in Central Falls, Rhode Island, the Elizabeth Buffum Chace Post Office. It changes only the name used for the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 13, 2019, when it was signed into law.
